comment: We didnt get any feedback on homework assignments so we didnt know how to improve. Expectations were never fully clear. No in-class activities except for the final project. She cared about us but the class was so boring and the midterm was incredibly hard. Expect lots of memorization and little critical thinking.

This is a theatre introduction class. It was my hardest class. Her instructions for most homework and projects were super unclear and her grading criteria makes no sense. This is class is so easy with any other teacher, avoid if you can.
worst teacher ever. do not take her class. Hardest class I've taken.
